overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the signed minutes were unapproved drafts not meant as final, so approval outside a meeting and missing details like location did not violate the law, though the AG reminded the Commission that final minutes must include location.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission approved its July 29, 2014 meeting minutes outside of a meeting, citing signatures on draft minutes.
allegations.key_passage: Because the minutes provided to Ms. Leach were draft minutes, we find that the Commission did not violate the law by approving minutes outside of an open meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission's minutes lacked required details, such as the meeting location.
allegations.key_passage: Furthermore, because these were draft minutes, we find that the Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law by failing to include required details, such as the meeting location.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
